# netbox_data_source (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/core/datasource/):

> A data source is a remote location, such as a git repository, that NetBox syncs files from.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_data_source" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `source_url` (String)
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- `ignore_rules` (String) Patterns (one per line) matching files or paths to ignore when syncing.
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `parameters` (String)
- `sync_interval` (Number) One of [1, 60, 720, 1440, 10080, 43200].
- `tags` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
